title: Emerging Sectors in Indian Startup Ecosystem in 2026 | Top Startup Industries | VenturLoop Publications | VenturLoop
snippet:
India's startup ecosystem is entering a new phase. While fintech, e-commerce, SaaS and consumer internet have played a major role in the country's startup growth, new opportunities are emerging across technology-intensive and strategically important industries. In 2026, sectors such as artificial intelligence, deeptech, spacetech, climate tech, biotechnology, semiconductors, robotics, healthtech, defence tech and digital agriculture are attracting increasing attention from founders, investors [...] Artificial intelligence is one of the most important emerging startup sectors in India in 2026. AI is no longer limited to technology companies and is increasingly being applied to healthcare, agriculture, education, financial services, cybersecurity, manufacturing and enterprise operations. title: India's Startup & Tech Growth 2026 | PDF
snippet: India's startup and tech ecosystem is rapidly growing, driven by digital adoption and AI innovation, with Reliance Industries and Tata Consultancy Services leading the way. The quick-commerce sector is thriving with Zepto's 10-minute delivery model, while fintech platforms like PhonePe and Paytm dominate digital payments. Overall, sectors such as EVs, AI, and SaaS are expected to continue their growth, presenting significant opportunities for entrepreneurs and professionals.

title: AI Roles Now Drive One-Third of Startup Tech Hiring in India: foundit Report
snippet:
The report also highlighted growing hiring momentum outside traditional metro hubs. Tier-2 and Tier-3 cities accounted for 36% of startup jobs in April 2026, compared to just 9% in April 2024. Cities such as Jaipur, Indore, Kochi, and Coimbatore are increasingly attracting startup activity due to lower operational costs and improving talent availability. [...] Technology-led hiring continued to dominate the startup ecosystem, with IT services accounting for 34% of startup jobs, while emerging technology, AI, and SaaS roles contributed around 14% of overall hiring. The report also showed AI and data-related roles now make up nearly one-third of startup technology hiring, rising from 24% last year to 32% in 2026. [...] Advertisment

The report projected startup hiring to grow 12% year-on-year in 2026, with startup jobs increasing from 116,080 in April 2025 to 130,010 in April 2026, adding nearly 14,000 new roles over the year.
